basics.name: Rishavh Shukla
basics.label: Senior Software Engineer - Salesforce x Agentic AI x Embedded

First developer on ArcelorMittal's Salesforce team; led KT sessions and Aura-to-LWC modernization; top delivery velocity (6-7 stories/release vs 2-3 norm). Built metadata-driven org-to-org data migration tooling. 7x Salesforce certified. 10+ years building and flying FPV drones; open-source hardware/firmware author (ShutterLink) and agentic AI builder (QuantDeck).
